newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Deceuninck to build plant in Poland.
newsitem.headline: Deceuninck to build plant in Poland.

text.p: Belgian PVC profiles producer Deceuninck said on Wednesday it would build a PVC profiles plant in Poland.
It is due to be operational by the end of this year, Deceuninck said in a statement. It gave no financial details.
Deceuninck said it had bought a site in Swarzedz, an industrial parc near Poznan, for the construction of a plant including a production unit, a storage room, sales office and training centre.
The subsidiary will be led by local management and focus on PVC profiles, which are popular on the Polish market.
Deceuninck said its turnover in East and Central Europe had risen strongly to 13 percent of total group turnover with Poland accounting for the bulk of it.
The statement said Deceuninck was aiming for a considerable rise in turnover by the year 2000 with East and Central Europe accounting for a quarter.
